weeks.content:
Say the truth always
Return what is not mine

Keep my own bag and bottle
Do my little jobs myself

Stand for the anthem
Handle the flag with respect

Name the teacher, doctor, nurse and police
Say what each one does

Feed animals gently
Do not throw stones at animals

Behaviour in the market and worship places
Use a quiet voice in public

Use words, not hands
Call the teacher when it is too big

Brush my teeth twice daily
Comb my hair, trim my nails

Every child deserves food, love and school
Tell a trusted adult when I feel unsafe

Dress and greet in our cultures
Recite our manners rules
